LanguageData.VPAP_Hint: Choose an age on the left, then click a picture to use it there. A look also covers the earlier ages until you give them their own.
LanguageData.VPAP_NamesOnlyGraphic: This art can't come from another mod. Only single, stack, random and four-facing art can, not walls and other art that joins its neighbours. You can still name it for each age.
LanguageData.VPAP_NamesOnlyApparel: A pick can't change worn art, so apparel takes names only.
LanguageData.VPAP_NoChangedItems: Nothing changed yet. Find an item under Items or a building under Buildings.
LanguageData.VPAP_ExportAsPackTip: Write your picks as a pack in your Mods folder, to keep or share. Art from other mods stays in those mods, and the pack lists them as requirements.
LanguageData.VPAP_NameTheExport: Give the pack a name and an author.
LanguageData.VPAP_ReplaceExport: Your Mods folder already has a folder named {0}. Replace the pack's files in it?
LanguageData.VPAP_ExportAfter: Restart to see it in the mod list. Your picks stay, and they win over the pack, so nothing changes until you reset them.
